name: io.github.theprodsde/agent-memory
description: Persistent agent memory with a decision layer: replay, restore, verify, or none — explainable.

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_MEMORY_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the persistent memory store (default: ~/.agent_memory)

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_MEMORY_COLLECTION
environmentVariables.description: Collection (database) name within the memory directory

tools.name: resolve_memory
tools.description: Retrieve memory and decide how the agent should respond. Returns one of four actions: replay (return stored response verbatim), restore (inject as context), verify (validate before reuse), or none (answer fresh). Includes confidence score and reasoning.

tools.name: remember_memory
tools.description: Store a query/response pair in persistent agent memory with optional tags, type, scope, confidence, TTL, and verification flag.

tools.name: list_memories
tools.description: List stored memories with pagination, scope filter, and optional archived entries.

tools.name: get_memory_by_id
tools.description: Fetch a single memory entry by its ID, including full response and metadata.

tools.name: forget_memory
tools.description: Permanently delete a memory by ID.

tools.name: archive_memory
tools.description: Archive a memory so it is excluded from future retrieval without deleting it.

tools.name: consolidate_memories
tools.description: Merge near-duplicate memories into summary entries, reducing redundancy in the store.
